Forge.Title: Crafting Table
Forge.BookEmpty: Craft something to record its recipe here.
Forge.FillHint: Lay out this recipe from your inventory
Forge.MissingHint: You are missing ingredients for this recipe
Forge.ReadyOnly: Only what you can craft now
Forge.DragResult: Already in your inventory. Drag it to the map or another sheet.
Forge.BookEmptyDismantle: Dismantle something to record its recipe here.
Forge.FillInputHint: Put this item in the circle
Forge.DropInputHint: Drag an item here from the character's sheet to dismantle it
Forge.UntriedHint: Never dismantled before: dismantle it to find out what it gives.
Forge.MissingInputHint: You lack the item or what dismantling it needs
Forge.ReadyOnlyDismantle: Only what you can dismantle now

Editor.Title: Recipe Book (GM)
Editor.CategoryHint: Group this recipe under one or more categories. It is listed in each.
Editor.DropResult: Drop the item this recipe makes
Editor.DropRequires: Drop an item the character must carry. It is never spent; any type counts.
Editor.ShapedHint: Items must keep these positions. The pattern may sit anywhere on the grid.
Editor.ShapelessHint: Only the items count, not where they are placed.
Editor.PublicHint: Every character knows a public recipe. Characters who learned it keep it if it stops being public.
Editor.DiscoveryHint: Can a character who doesn't know this recipe make it by laying out its ingredients? Making it teaches it. World default follows the module setting.
Editor.RestoreConfirm: Restore {name} to the version {source} provides? Your changes to it are lost.
Editor.DuplicateHint: Duplicate as a new world recipe
Editor.CreateDismantleHint: Create a dismantling recipe from this variant
Editor.HideHint: Move to Hidden, at the bottom of the list. Nothing changes in play.
Editor.ShareHint: Show this recipe to the players you choose. They can learn it from there.
Editor.TeachHint: Teach this recipe to the characters you choose.
Editor.ForgetHint: Remove this recipe from the characters you choose.
Editor.DiscardChanges: This recipe has unsaved changes. Discard them?
Editor.QuantityHint: How many of the result one successful craft makes. Items with a quantity get one stack; items without one arrive as separate copies.
Editor.ConsumesHint: How many of the item one dismantling breaks.
Editor.RefundHint: An item made at the table breaks back into exactly what was spent on it.
Editor.RefundOtherHint: Bought, looted or given, it breaks into the parts on the grid. When the grid follows a way of making the item, light the cheapest.

Teach.Title: Teach: {name}
Teach.ShowCharacters: Clear the selection and show the characters
Teach.Empty: No user has a character assigned. Select tokens on the map to teach them.

Forget.Title: Forget: {name}
Forget.Empty: None of these characters learned this. Select tokens on the map to see others.

Chat.FailureMessage: The materials refuse to come together.
Chat.RefusedMessage: It could not be added to {name}'s inventory. Nothing was spent.
Chat.IncompleteMessage: These materials were spent, but the result never reached {name}. The GM should fix it by hand.
Chat.Kept: The materials survived ({chance}% chance of loss).

Errors.NoActor: There is no character to craft for: your user has none assigned. Ask the GM to assign you one.
Errors.NoActorGM: There is no character to craft for. Select a token on the map, or assign a character to your user.
Errors.EmptyGrid: Place some materials on the grid first.
Errors.Vetoed: Another module or the game system stopped this craft without giving a reason. Nothing was spent.
Errors.DismantleVetoed: Another module or the game system stopped this dismantling without giving a reason. Nothing was spent.
Errors.ItemGone: {name} is gone: it was used, moved or deleted after you placed it. Place it again.
Errors.NotEnough: There isn't enough {name} on the character's sheet for this grid.
Errors.AllOnGrid: All the {name} the character carries is already on the grid.
Errors.DismantleNotEnough: Dismantling {name} takes {count} at a time, and the character carries fewer.
Errors.CannotDismantle: {name} can't be dismantled: the character knows no way to take it apart.
Errors.ResultGone: The item this recipe makes ({name}) no longer exists. Ask the GM to fix the recipe.
Errors.PartGone: Dismantling {name} would give {part}, which no longer exists. Nothing was spent. Ask the GM to fix the dismantling recipe.
Errors.TypeNotAllowed: {name} can't be used: {type} items aren't crafting materials in this world. The GM chooses which types are in the module settings.
Errors.NotYourCharacter: {name} belongs to {owner}. Only items on your own character's sheet can be used.
Errors.NotCraftingActor: {name} belongs to {owner}, but the table is working for {actor}. Select {owner}'s token to use it.
Errors.UnlinkedToken: {name} comes from {owner}'s sheet in the Actors directory, but the selected token isn't linked to that actor and carries its own copy of the items. Open the sheet from the token and drag {name} from there.
Errors.NotFromInventory: {name} isn't on your character's sheet. Only items your character carries can be used.
Errors.DismantleNotCarried: {name} isn't on a character's sheet. Only an item a character carries can be dismantled.
Errors.MissingIngredients: The character doesn't carry every ingredient {name} needs.
Errors.EmptyCircle: Put the item to dismantle in the circle first: drag it from the character's sheet.
Errors.FromActor: {name} exists only on a character's sheet. Use the item from the Items directory or a compendium.
Errors.NoResult: Drop the item this recipe makes in the result slot.
Errors.NoIngredients: Place at least one ingredient on the grid.
Errors.NoInput: Drop the item to dismantle in the circle.
Errors.NoOutputs: Place at least one part on the grid.
Errors.GMOnly: Only a GM can do that.
Errors.NotAnActor: Pass an actor or a token, or the uuid of one.
Errors.UnknownRecipe: There is no recipe with the id {id}.
Errors.SaveBeforeSharing: Save the recipe before sharing it.
Errors.ShareMissed: The recipe could not be shown to {names}.
Errors.UserIdsNotList: Pass the players as a list of user ids.
Errors.CategoriesNotList: Pass the categories as a list of names.

RecipeEditor.Name: Recipes
RecipeEditor.Label: Open Recipe Book
RecipeEditor.Hint: Create and edit the world's crafting recipes.

ItemTypes.Name: Craftable Item Types
ItemTypes.Label: Choose Item Types
ItemTypes.Hint: Which item types can be placed on a crafting grid.
ItemTypes.Explain: Only checked item types can be used as crafting materials. With none checked, every type is allowed.

Theme.Name: Visual Theme
Theme.Hint: The look and sound of the crafting table for everyone at the table.

QuantityPath.Name: Quantity Path
QuantityPath.Hint: Where this system keeps an item's quantity, such as system.quantity. Crafting spends one unit per grid cell; items without a number there are used up whole.

FailLossChance.Name: Failure: Chance to Lose Materials
FailLossChance.Hint: Percent chance that a failed craft destroys the materials. 0 means failure has no consequences. Each recipe can override it.

Discovery.Name: Discover Recipes by Experiment
Discovery.Hint: Characters can make a recipe they don't know by laying out its ingredients (in its shape, if it has one), and learn it. Each recipe can override this.

Settings.SoundHint: Leave empty to use the visual theme's own sound.

Sounds.Name: Crafting Sounds
Sounds.Label: Configure Sounds
Sounds.Hint: Base volume and the sound files for crafting, success, failure and shared recipes. Players hear them on their Interface volume.
